Fixed in the shipped crate: src-tauri/vendor/glib-0.18.5 = crates.io glib 0.18.5 + upstream fix b5a4071e (VariantStrIter::impl_get), wired by [patch.crates-io]; proven byte-for-byte by scripts/supply-chain/glib-vendor-check.sh. Portable AppImage (#298). Skia SkBmpStandardCodec.cpp (initializeSwizzler) is in the webkitgtk-2.52.6 tarball but NOT in WebKit's Skia CMake source list (0 CMake mentions of SkBmpStandardCodec/SkBmpCodec; compiled Skia codecs = SkCodec core, Jpeg*, Png*, Swizzler, Sampler); 0 SkBmpStandardCodec strings in the bundled libwebkit2gtk-4.1.so.0. WebKit decodes BMP with its own BMPImageDecoder. Evidence: packaging/appimage/inventory/reachability/reach.out, packaging/appimage/inventory/reachability/reach2.out ("codec files compiled"). Re-check on any WebKitGTK bump.

VEX status: AFFECTED (CycloneDX 1.6 has no "affected" state; "exploitable" is its encoding of affected/known_affected). Portable AppImage (#298). Impact (WSA-2026-0006, packaging/appimage/inventory/wsa/0006.txt): out-of-bounds write from an integer overflow in filterMask of Skia SkEmbossMaskFilter.cpp; may lead to remote code execution, no extra privileges, no user interaction; critical. Present: src/effects/SkEmbossMaskFilter.cpp is in the Skia CMake source list of webkitgtk-2.52.6 (l.544) and the SkEmbossMaskFilter symbol string is in the bundled libwebkit2gtk-4.1.so.0 (reach.out, reach2.out). Reachable surface: WebKitGTK 2.52 renders with Skia (USE_SKIA ON), so any content the opensidian webview renders reaches the Skia mask-filter code: vault notes (markdown with inline HTML/SVG, images, CSS), canvas/SVG filter effects, plugin and theme CSS/JS, and any remote page or embed loaded in the webview. We have NOT shown that WebKit calls SkEmbossMaskFilter for a given input, nor that it never does; fail closed: treated as reachable. Fixed upstream only in WebKitGTK 2.54.0 (packaging/appimage/inventory/wsa/delta.tsv); Ubuntu 26.04 ships 2.52.6 with no fix. Host-webkit formats (flatpak/deb/rpm) use the runtime/distro webkit2gtk and are not covered by this entry.

properties.name: opensidian:action_statement
properties.value: Decision 2026-11-24 (operator): no self-built WebKitGTK. We adopt the first distro/runtime webkit2gtk >= 2.54.0 that becomes available for the AppImage build base and bump the bundle then. Until then the portable AppImage ships the affected webkit2gtk 2.52.6; this finding stays visible in every osv scan (vex-osv-config.sh does not ignore exploitable entries).

analysis.detail: Portable AppImage (#298). Adobe DNG SDK (dng_misc_opcodes.cpp ProcessArea) is not part of WebKitGTK: no dng_* file in the webkitgtk-2.52.6 Skia tree, 0 CMake mentions, 0 dng_ strings in libwebkit2gtk-4.1.so.0. Evidence: packaging/appimage/inventory/reachability/reach.out. Re-check on any WebKitGTK bump.

Portable AppImage (#298). The RTCP SDES parser lives in libgstrtp-1.0, which the AppImage does not bundle (bundled gst libs: allocators app audio base fft gl pbutils gstreamer tag video, both arches); 0 gst_rtcp/gst_rtp strings in all 10 bundled gst libs and libwebkit2gtk imports no gst_rtcp*. Enforced: scripts/supply-chain/appimage-excl-check.sh VEX_ABSENT_RE fails the build if libgstrtp-1.0 is bundled. Evidence: packaging/appimage/inventory/reachability/reach.out. Host gstreamer is the host's.

Portable AppImage (#298). The overflow is in the xmlcatalog command-line tool (--shell usershell()), not in libxml2.so; the AppImage ships only libxml2.so.16, no xmlcatalog binary (full file list: packaging/appimage/inventory/inventory-v0.9.6-x86_64.tsv). Enforced: appimage-excl-check.sh VEX_ABSENT_RE fails the build if xmlcatalog is bundled.

Portable AppImage (#298). The flaw is in systemd-gpt-auto-generator (boot-time generator); the AppImage ships only the client libraries libsystemd.so.0 / libudev.so.1, no generator binary (0 gpt-auto strings in libsystemd.so.0). Enforced: appimage-excl-check.sh VEX_ABSENT_RE. Evidence: packaging/appimage/inventory/reachability/reach.out, inventory-v0.9.6-x86_64.tsv.

Portable AppImage (#298). The flaw is in the systemd-journald daemon (ForwardToWall); the AppImage ships only libsystemd.so.0 (webkit/JSC import the sd_journal_send client call, which writes to the HOST journald), no journald binary. Enforced: appimage-excl-check.sh VEX_ABSENT_RE. Evidence: packaging/appimage/inventory/reachability/reach.out, inventory-v0.9.6-x86_64.tsv.

pdf.js 6.1.200 compiled into the bundled libwebkit2gtk 2.52.6 (built-in PDF viewer; nested component of webkit2gtk in the portable AppImage SBOM, #299). Exploit needs WebKit to open an attacker PDF. opensidian never hands one to a webview: vault PDFs are rasterised natively by hayro and served as PNG only (src-tauri/src/pdf.rs, raw bytes never reach the webview); every navigation of every webview is limited to tauri://localhost (main.rs nav_allowed + on_navigation); CSP default-src self with no frame-src/object-src override blocks frames/embeds of any other origin, blob: and data:; ui/ ships no PDF. The vendored ui/vendor pdfjs-dist 6.3.289 is outside the affected range (< 6.2.108). Fix = a WebKitGTK bundling pdf.js >= 6.2.108 (AppImage WebKit, #298).
